name: B10-0287/2025 (Renew) – Media freedom in Georgia, particularly the case of Mzia Amaglobeli
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on media freedom in Georgia, particularly the case of Mzia Amaglobeli
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making requests. It asks for the release of journalist Mzia Amaglobeli, held since January 2025 and facing four to seven years in prison. It also asks for the release of other jailed protesters and opposition figures, for an end to pressure on independent media, and for European Union countries to sanction Georgian officials. These are opinions and calls, not decisions that change anything by themselves.

- The Parliament calls for Amaglobeli's release and all charges dropped; Georgian authorities decide.
- It urges European Union countries to sanction Georgian officials, including Bidzina Ivanishvili.
- It says the European Union will not recognise the current president and parliament until new elections.
